scope: Read-only review of capture_mode_switches.py and synthetic tests; no board access, no firmware/source edits.
checks: PLAN contains 50 actual target changes from prepared CAP8; MODE and ROWMODES domains are verified using accepted ID and atomic CONFIG.
MIXED permits CONFIG.state=CAPACITANCE while requiring mode=MIXED, rows=8, full CVRCVRCV profile, correct row modes and units.
CAP legacy gen/rid use rows domain; full identity includes session/boot/revision/mode/rows/profile domains.
Queued old revisions are preserved and counted within the same boot/session using half-range comparison; future or foreign-boot identities fail.
Lost terminal may recover through accepted request ID plus CONFIG; unconfirmed setters are not replayed.
Exclusive-create raw/events/summary files, contiguous receive offsets and SHA preserve original raw evidence.
One shared monotonic total deadline reserves cleanup; original failure and cleanup failure are separate.
No reset, power fault, CAL SAVE, speed setter, input flush or USBSTREAM setter.

executed_checks.execution_evidence: Actual terminal tool execution in this review; fixture uses synthetic CDC firmware and never enumerates hardware.

checks: BadCrc subclass flips one CRC bit while keeping the original frame body; requires ERROR, zero verified transitions and CAP8_QUERY_VERIFIED cleanup.
EarlyData subclass injects a complete synthetic Firmware.frame before each MAPP/RMAPP; requires COMPLETE_50_IDENTITY_VERIFIED and raw first V frame preceding first MAPP.
executed_checks.reproducibility: Ad hoc code was executed from a temporary inline heredoc and was not saved as a maintained regression fixture. These results are supporting review evidence, not a claimed reproducible fixture/test-suite addition.

limitations: No HIL or RF test was performed by this reviewer.
Complete CRC-valid frames establish wire/configuration identity; point accuracy and nonzero acquired masks are not asserted.
Application deadlines assume OS I/O and scheduler progress; arbitrary blocked host filesystem/system calls are not forcibly cancelled.
The two additional inline checks are not maintained regression fixtures.
